program_scope: Two native hosts cover 150 cases each: the existing 25 Seq/All frontiers with zero predecessors, one same-kind predecessor or all four two-predecessor kind pairs. Source compilation, original parent/collector recovery and scope cancellation are reused. Original owners and host objects drop before same-process disk reopening.
settlement_scope: The host fixture distinguishes Completed, Failed and Cancelled terminal outcomes. Explicit cancellation revokes the shared scope and observes parent/collector cancellation before publishing an intent and then a Cancelled terminal. Only successful terminal publication returns a cancellation acknowledgement. Completed and Failed records already committed take precedence over late cancellation without rewriting bytes.
intent_scope: A committed intent without terminal refuses ordinary recovery before VM/capture restoration. An authorized cancellation retry may finish the terminal without work dispatch. Repeated terminal-publication failure and permission refusal leave the intent ledger byte-identical. Failure before the intent is published returns no acknowledgement and gives no persisted restart fence; the local owner is closed but host uncertainty remains unresolved.
writer_scope: The test-only serialized writer bounds encoded bytes, exclusively creates a temporary file, writes and syncs that file, then renames it over the ledger. Deterministic faults after file sync and before rename exercise both intent and terminal publication failure; failed candidates are removed so explicit retries can succeed. Directory synchronization, subprocess kill, power loss, concurrent writers and transactional check-and-dispatch are not tested or promised.
dispatch_scope: The existing host dispatch fixture re-reads the persisted cancellation/terminal fence before consulting a stale in-memory receipt ledger or invoking an effect. Six hundred independently fresh adapter attempts refuse after a confirmed cancellation or interrupted terminal publication. This is not atomic with concurrent cancellation, does not deliver external cancellation and does not roll back operations already executing elsewhere.
validation_scope: Fresh authority still precedes terminal replay. Cancelled records require an intent, no value and the original saved remaining fuel; Completed/Failed records require the appropriate value shape, no cancellation intent and no budget increase. Twenty-four contradictory terminal records refuse ordinary replay and cancellation retry. Four malformed Seq/All collector restores cannot be mislabeled as confirmed cancellation; an explicit observed-cancellation flag separates that path from restore errors.
remaining_boundaries: Actual subprocess restart/termination and durable filesystem/crash consistency.
Concurrent writer coordination and atomic external-effect/receipt/cancellation settlement.
External cancellation delivery, authenticated host storage and final independent repository/distribution acceptance.
verification_scope: Local macOS serialized same-process disk-reopen acceptance. Matrix totals are scenarios inside six added Rust tests; local/package/consumer tests overlap. No Linux, physical GUI, remote CI, production journal or complete durable recovery claim.
